title: In Transformer We Trust? A Perspective on Transformer Architecture Failure Modes

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature on statistical co-occurrence in language models (e.g., probability shifts in gender-occupation associations and pronoun resolution in machine translation) and evaluating Accuracy Difference (Δ) metrics in Vision Transformers for visual occupational stereotypes.
Discussing automated evaluation frameworks (like Robustness Gym) that construct targeted data slices to measure performance degradation and robustness across underrepresented subpopulations.
